name: Caddy 现代 Web 服务器
description: 基于 Node.js 原生驱动的 Caddy 服务生命周期控制、Admin API 探测与 Caddyfile 语法预检热重载

installGuide.debian: curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_20.x | bash - && apt install -y nodejs && apt install -y debian-keyring debian-archive-keyring apt-transport-https && curl -1sLf 'https://dl.cloudsmith.io/public/caddy/stable/gpg.key' | gpg --dearmor -o /usr/share/keyrings/caddy-stable-archive-keyring.gpg && curl -1sLf 'https://dl.cloudsmith.io/public/caddy/stable/debian.deb.txt' | tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/caddy-stable.list && apt update && apt install -y caddy
installGuide.rhel: dnf module install -y nodejs:20 && dnf copr enable @caddy/caddy && dnf install -y caddy
installGuide.windows: winget install OpenJS.NodeJS.LTS ; winget install CaddyServer.Caddy
